what_happened: Found the actual Sapience server source (brain_server.py, repo_link.py) and the vendor CLI dev-source (sapience_cli.py, with link_cmd) in a separate local checkout (~/Projects/Sapience/sapience-app), letting every status-code/response-shape claim in the dispatch be verified against ground truth instead of this extension's own flagged-stale deployed docs.

The dispatch's requirement (3) (a 404 from the link route must still write the binding file and report a degraded state) and requirement (4) (delegate pick-and-register to the vendor 'sapience link' CLI when installed) are not jointly satisfiable by pure delegation: the vendor CLI's own link_cmd writes nothing on a 404 ('Nothing was written.'). The plan must explicitly choose between (a) delegating only the pick/match step and keeping this script's own POST+write (and thus its 404 handling) in both the fallback and delegate paths, or (b) delegating fully and special-casing the vendor's 404 exit to perform the same write itself.

sapience-publish.sh's ko subcommand and sapience-vault-read.sh's notes_cid resolution both parse GET /v1/people/projects with a jq shape ('.projects' or bare array) that matches neither the real server response ({shared, received, ...}, confirmed by direct brain_server.py read) nor any other /v1/people/projects*-family response found in the server source -- likely a pre-existing silent-empty-result bug in both, out of this task's declared territory (neither file is in the Territory list) so not touched here, but recorded so the new pick-mode code in sapience-project-bind.sh does not copy the same incorrect pattern, and as a candidate follow-up task.

The dispatch's requirement (3) (a 404 from the link route must still write .sapience/project.json) and requirement (4) (delegate pick-and-register to the vendor 'sapience link' when available) are not simultaneously satisfiable by pure delegation: the vendor link_cmd writes nothing on 404 ('Nothing was written.'). Resolved in the plan by delegating the bind but making this script the SOLE writer and falling through to its own status-code-classified HTTP path whenever the vendor exits non-zero or leaves no file -- never parsing vendor stderr prose. Recorded as a plan Decision.

The research report ground-truthed every server response shape, gate order, and the vendor client's link_cmd against live source, so plan authoring needed only four confirmatory greps (link route absent from the extension, installed client lacking 'sub == "link"', the script's three flags, the two existing GET /v1/people/projects consumers) rather than a second investigation pass.

Concurrent sibling task 683 declares agent-system/extensions/sapience/context/project/sapience/domain/per-repo-scoping.md in its own file_scope -- the same file this plan's final phase edits. Flagged in the plan's Risks with an append-a-new-section-only mitigation and a re-read-immediately-before-editing directive.

verify-touched.sh invokes run-all.sh in deployed mode by default, which resolves test-sapience-project-bind.sh and sapience-project-bind.sh from the stale .claude/scripts mirror rather than the edited source store; the authoritative Phase 1 check is the direct CORE_TEST_SUBJECT_MODE=source-store invocation of the suite (36/36 passed), already documented as a known risk in the plan's Risks table and deferred to the orchestration-close redeploy.

sapience_post's documented sapience_api_post_http_status caller-visible status variable never actually reaches the caller when invoked via `x=$(sapience_post ...)` command substitution, because that forks a subshell; the fix (redirecting sapience_post's stdout to a temp file instead, keeping the call in-process) stayed entirely inside sapience-project-bind.sh, so sapience-api-lib.sh (out of this phase's file_scope) needed no edit.

Phase 3 (vendor delegation + single-writer normalization) implemented exactly per the plan's D1 design with no deviations; all 24 test cases (61 assertions) passed on first full run after shellcheck/bash-n were already clean.

Plan Phase 4's Stage 7 task named a single '--project <id>' preview but sapience-project-bind.sh's pick mode can return zero, one, or many rows; the plan did not specify disambiguation. Resolved by reusing Stage 5's existing exactly-one-or-refuse discipline rather than inventing a new mechanism or a second AskUserQuestion (an explicit Non-Goal).

Drafting Stage 1's new prose with 'this is no longer a stop' triggered no-record-versioning-in-deliverables.md's forbidden-phrase list even though it described a behavior change, not document draft history. Caught and reworded to 'this is not a hard stop' before committing.

Phase 5 discovered that linked-repo-write-policy.md's Ruling 5 (committed by task 678, out of this task's declared territory) asserts 'this repo's own binding is always the owner side -- sapience-project-bind.sh always creates a fresh project rather than joining one,' which Phases 1-3 of this same task invalidated by adding a --project bind-to-existing mode that can make this repo a non-creator accepted member. The in-territory copy of the same stale sentence, in command-draft-and-picker.md's own Ruling 5, was corrected as part of this phase. linked-repo-write-policy.md needs the identical correction as a follow-up task, since it is outside agent-system/extensions/sapience/(scripts/sapience-project-bind.sh, scripts/lib/sapience-api-lib.sh, commands/sapience.md, skills/skill-sapience/SKILL.md, context/project/sapience/domain/per-repo-scoping.md and command-draft-and-picker.md, scripts/tests/test-sapience-project-bind.sh).

Phase 5's Scope Hypothesis (per-repo-scoping.md carries no repo-link section; command-draft-and-picker.md's surface table has exactly four rows) held exactly as predicted despite task 678 (a concurrent-dispatch-order but fully completed and committed prior task) having already edited both files in the interim to add Ruling 5 and its cross-reference -- confirmed by grep before editing rather than assumed.
git-commit-phase.sh dropped 'agent-system/extensions/sapience/index-entries.json' from a phase commit pathspec: not contained in this task's declared file_scope.
